motivation: E149 exact map still has35/48 six-joint successes and11 collisions; those collisions include arm links3/4 against the table during approach/descent/lift. Better motion-map accuracy alone does not choose a good posture. Test one fixed observation-only secondary posture objective before further estimator fitting.
change: After each original non-probe task command, compute N=I-J^T(JJ^T+.015^2 I)^-1 J using that controller current map. Add N*.05*(home-q), uniformly scaled so max absolute component<=.01rad, then original +/- .04 action clamp. Home is the original supplied safe starting posture, not an oracle future posture. Damped projection is approximate; log induced task-space motion and clipping. Fixed calibration and local probe actions are untouched. Frozen measured bias and all task waypoints/budgets remain unchanged.
comparisons: All96 fitting placements for uniform32, E120 three-model ensemble, E146 learned-prior three-model ensemble, and explicitly privileged exact map. Each receives identical posture rule; compare matched original no-posture results as well. No hyperparameter sweep, body-specific routing, task-value gate, physics selector, geometry lookup or new learned weights. Exact map remains reference only.
screen: A learned candidate only warrants fresh testing if it exceeds the matched E120 ensemble, is at least the matched uniform32 success count, does not decline on either joint count versus matched E120, has no more collision episodes, and retains fitting gain placements1,13,18. Report every lost success and distinguish controller improvement from learned-estimator improvement. E120 remains unchanged.
